description: Agent-agnostic skills for coding agents, verified on Claude Code, Codex, and Copilot. Includes screenwright, which builds a UI from a design spec, then renders it, audits accessibility, and fixes what does not match.

Open-source AI pixel art studio for game developers: generate, edit, animate and export sprites, icons, sprite sheets, seamless textures, autotile tilesets, tile maps and nine-slice UI with exact pixel-grid control. Works with OpenRouter, OpenAI and PixelLab.
Autonomous AI agent skill for generating, auditing, and exporting flawless 2D pixel art game assets. Powered by Google Antigravity IDE.
Agent Skill for generating 2D sprite sheets and map, transparent PNG frames, and animated GIFs from prompts.
Agent skills extracted from game-development work and related agentic-workflow research
A simple web-based tool for Spriting and Pixel art.
